note: Headline MRR and R@5 per configuration. A later run failing against this file means recall quality moved. keyword-legacy is different in kind: it is a frozen copy of the pre-change path, so its numbers must stay put forever — a drift there means the copy stopped being faithful to what shipped, not that anything improved. It was verified against the real pre-change code, which measured MRR 0.2643 and R@5 0.4219. The two `*-model` rows are recorded only when fastembed is installed; a run without it reports them as not run and the comparison skips them, so a machine with no model never sees a false regression.
